resources.string: Modern libxposed API 102 template for rooted Vector and rootless LSPatch 1.0, with a movable Nyx-styled overlay and optional ShadowHook native scaffold.

LSPosed Universal Template

1. Edit TemplateConfig.TARGET_PACKAGES.
2. Edit META-INF/xposed/scope.list.
3. Build: ./gradlew :app:assembleRelease
4. For Vector, install and enable app-release.apk.
 For LSPatch 1.0, embed the same APK while patching the target.

Current first target: %1$s

The in-app Nyx bubble appears inside the target Activity after Application.attach. Tap it to open the rectangular panel; drag the panel header to move it.
